# Vendored copy of civitai-bulk-downloader

Source: https://github.com/deepratna-awale/civitai-bulk-downloader at commit
`e2d43fccdd12614bc92de5345900cd39a3896b10` (MIT licensed, see `LICENSE`).

Only the package (`civitai_downloader/`), `pyproject.toml`, `README.md` and `LICENSE` are copied; the
tests, CSV templates and CI files are left out. The image installs it from this folder, so a build
doesn't depend on that repository and always gets this exact code. To update, copy the same files
from a newer commit and update the commit above.
